in_sanskrit.name: गजराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over elephants. A name for a powerful and majestic king.

in_marathi.name: Gajraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gajraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'gaja' meaning elephant and 'raja' meaning king. In Hindu mythology, Gajraj is a name given to Lord Indra, the king of gods, who is often depicted riding an elephant. The name signifies power, strength, and royalty.
